description_blocks.text: Overview

The 4x4 Mini Off-Roader – CyberBrick RC is a fully functional, modular, 3D printable remote control off-road vehicle designed for hobbyists, makers, and enthusiasts. At its core is a printable dual differential drivetrain paired with a robust body-on-frame chassis, delivering true Four Wheel Drive performance that can handle sand, grass, gravel, and more.

The journey from digital files to a fully drivable Off-Roader is a big part of the magic. It gives builders hands-on experience with mechanical design, assembly, and problem-solving, making it a rewarding project for individuals, parents, and kids to learn and create together.
Start your build adventure. Download the model, prepare your printer, and gather the CyberBrick kits to engineer your own rugged, high-performance 4x4 Mini Off-Roader – CyberBrick RC.
Find all files and details on its MakerWorld Page.
*For a smooth build, we recommend reviewing the assembly guide first.
Design & Performance
Engineered to confidently conquer diverse landscapes such as sand, grass, and gravel. Its off-road capability is ensured by three key features:
High Ground Clearance: Allows the vehicle to glide over obstacles and uneven terrain.
Independent Suspension: Provides responsive handling and improved traction on rough surfaces. Compatible with a range of aftermarket springs for customization.
Optional Large-Diameter Tires: Enhance grip and capability across loose or soft terrain.
Authentic Engineering & Off-Road Performance

True Four Wheel Drive with Differentials: Features a fully functional, printable dual differential drivetrain rather than a simple direct drive system. This allows each wheel to rotate at the appropriate speed during cornering, resulting in improved traction, smoother handling, and more realistic off-road behavior.

Durable Body-on-Frame Construction: Inspired by real off-road vehicles, the design uses a separate ladder frame with a removable body. This architecture provides excellent impact resistance while enabling easy customization, upgrades, and complete body swaps in the future.
Open Design & Customization Platform
This model is more than a kit. It is a starting point for your imagination:

Personalize Your Build: Print the Off-Roader body in any filament you choose. From vibrant colors to specialty materials, this freedom lets you design a vehicle that is a true reflection of your style.

Open-Source Customization: Included STEP files for the rims and chassis allow advanced users to modify wheel designs or create entirely new vehicle bodies, turning the kit into a platform for your own inventions.
Officially Verified Design: Both the model and instruction manual are officially tested to ensure successful printing and smooth assembly.
Performance-Oriented Printing Guide
For optimal performance, we recommend using different materials for flexible tires and for rigid structural parts.
Remote Control Instruction
The Model is designed to work with the CyberBrick Official Remote. Pre-configured settings have been prepared for immediate play,
while the CyberBrick App allows full customization of controller functions to match your personal preferences.
* Please visit the CyberBrick Official Standard Remote on Makerworld for more details.

Required Parts & Kit Compatibility (For Existing kit Owners)
For New Users: We recommend purchasing the all-in-one Packaged Kit ZL017, which contains all the necessary parts to build one complete vehicle.

For Existing Kit Owners: Due to the high quantity required, you will most likely need 1-2 extra packs of M2.5x6 BHCS Machine Screws and 1 Additional Pack of 2x12 mm Stainless Steel Dowel Pins (DA009). Also, each vehicle needs 1pcs of 180° 9g Servo Motor and 4 pieces of 0.6x8x20 mm Helical Compression Springs.
To help you understand what additional parts are needed based on the kit you own or plan to buy, please refer to the following table:
Core Safety Rules
This product is intended for users aged 16 and above. Users under the age of 16 must be under direct adult supervision throughout use.
DO NOT touch the moving parts while the device is operating to prevent pinching injuries.
Please use only official tools for any firmware operations. Flashing with third-party tools is not supported and may cause irreversible damage, which is not covered by warranty.
Before use, inspect all 3D-printed parts and sand down any sharp edges or burrs if present. Store the model and small parts in a location out of reach of children and pets to prevent choking hazards.
Warning of Lithium Battery
This product utilizes a replaceable rechargeable lithium battery.
Adult supervision is required when children are handling batteries or the charger. Do not operate the product while it is charging.
Ensure the battery is installed correctly. Improper installation may result in short circuits, overheating, or potential explosion.
Regularly inspect the charger’s cord, plug, housing, and other components for damage. If any damage is found, discontinue use immediately until the device is fully repaired.
Choking Hazard: Contains small parts; not suitable for children under 3 years of age.
Improper disposal of this product may harm the environment - please recycle responsibly.
Charging Precautions
Use only the officially supplied charger. The charger is not a toy.

The USB charger for this product only supports standard 5V 1-2A input. Please always use the original charger that meets the voltage/current requirements, or charge directly via a computer USB port. DO NOT use chargers with output higher than 5V or 2A (such as mobile fast chargers, 9V/12V adapters, etc.), as this may cause device damage, overheating, or even serious fire hazards.
DO NOT cover the device while charging, and keep it away from high temperature, humidity, or flammable environments. Never charge the device unattended.
DO NOT charge the battery pack if it is overheating. Allow it to cool down completely before recharging.
If the battery pack or charger becomes wet, ensure they are thoroughly dry before attempting to charge.
Lithium Battery Safety Precautions
DO NOT attempt to use or charge the battery pack if it shows any signs of leakage or corrosion.
DO NOT disassemble, crush, or mechanically abuse the battery pack.
DO NOT dispose of the battery pack in fire.
Exercise extreme caution when handling an overheated battery pack.

At its core is a printable dual differential drivetrain paired with a robust body-on-frame chassis, delivering true Four Wheel Drive performance that can handle sand, grass, gravel, and more.

The journey from digital files to a fully drivable Off-Roader is a big part of the magic. It gives builders hands-on experience with mechanical design, assembly, and problem-solving, making it a rewarding project for individuals, parents, and kids to learn and create together.

Start your build adventure. Download the model, prepare your printer, and gather the CyberBrick kits to engineer your own rugged, high-performance 4x4 Mini Off-Roader – CyberBrick RC.


Find all files and details on its MakerWorld Page.

*For a smooth build, we recommend reviewing the assembly guide first.

Design & Performance

Engineered to confidently conquer diverse landscapes such as sand, grass, and gravel. Its off-road capability is ensured by three key features:

  • High Ground Clearance: Allows the vehicle to glide over obstacles and uneven terrain.
  • Independent Suspension: Provides responsive handling and improved traction on rough surfaces. Compatible with a range of aftermarket springs for customization.
  • Optional Large-Diameter Tires: Enhance grip and capability across loose or soft terrain.

Authentic Engineering & Off-Road Performance

  • True Four Wheel Drive with Differentials: Features a fully functional, printable dual differential drivetrain rather than a simple direct drive system. This allows each wheel to rotate at the appropriate speed during cornering, resulting in improved traction, smoother handling, and more realistic off-road behavior.
  • Durable Body-on-Frame Construction: Inspired by real off-road vehicles, the design uses a separate ladder frame with a removable body. This architecture provides excellent impact resistance while enabling easy customization, upgrades, and complete body swaps in the future.

Open Design & Customization Platform

This model is more than a kit. It is a starting point for your imagination:

  • Personalize Your Build: Print the Off-Roader body in any filament you choose. From vibrant colors to specialty materials, this freedom lets you design a vehicle that is a true reflection of your style.
  • Open-Source Customization: Included STEP files for the rims and chassis allow advanced users to modify wheel designs or create entirely new vehicle bodies, turning the kit into a platform for your own inventions.
  • Officially Verified Design: Both the model and instruction manual are officially tested to ensure successful printing and smooth assembly.

Performance-Oriented Printing Guide

For optimal performance, we recommend using different materials for flexible tires and for rigid structural parts.

Parts Primary Goal Recommended Material Alternative Material
Tires Maximize Flexibility & Grip TPU 90A (Superior off-road traction) TPU 95A (Good balance of grip and printability)
Chassis & Drivetrain Maximize Strength & Stiffness PLA-CF / PETG / ASA (High durability and rigidity) -

Remote Control Instruction

The Model is designed to work with the CyberBrick Official Remote. Pre-configured settings have been prepared for immediate play,

while the CyberBrick App allows full customization of controller functions to match your personal preferences.

* Please visit the CyberBrick Official Standard Remote on Makerworld for more details.

Documentation

Important Notices

Core Safety Rules

  • This product is intended for users aged 16 and above. Users under the age of 16 must be under direct adult supervision throughout use.
  • DO NOT touch the moving parts while the device is operating to prevent pinching injuries.
  • Please use only official tools for any firmware operations. Flashing with third-party tools is not supported and may cause irreversible damage, which is not covered by warranty.
  • Before use, inspect all 3D-printed parts and sand down any sharp edges or burrs if present. Store the model and small parts in a location out of reach of children and pets to prevent choking hazards.

Warning of Lithium Battery

  • This product utilizes a replaceable rechargeable lithium battery.
  • Adult supervision is required when children are handling batteries or the charger. Do not operate the product while it is charging.
  • Ensure the battery is installed correctly. Improper installation may result in short circuits, overheating, or potential explosion.
  • Regularly inspect the charger’s cord, plug, housing, and other components for damage. If any damage is found, discontinue use immediately until the device is fully repaired.
  • Choking Hazard: Contains small parts; not suitable for children under 3 years of age.
  • Improper disposal of this product may harm the environment - please recycle responsibly.

Charging Precautions

  • Use only the officially supplied charger. The charger is not a toy.
  • The USB charger for this product only supports standard 5V 1-2A input. Please always use the original charger that meets the voltage/current requirements, or charge directly via a computer USB port. DO NOT use chargers with output higher than 5V or 2A (such as mobile fast chargers, 9V/12V adapters, etc.), as this may cause device damage, overheating, or even serious fire hazards.
  • DO NOT cover the device while charging, and keep it away from high temperature, humidity, or flammable environments. Never charge the device unattended.
  • DO NOT charge the battery pack if it is overheating. Allow it to cool down completely before recharging.
  • If the battery pack or charger becomes wet, ensure they are thoroughly dry before attempting to charge.

Lithium Battery Safety Precautions

  • DO NOT attempt to use or charge the battery pack if it shows any signs of leakage or corrosion.
  • DO NOT disassemble, crush, or mechanically abuse the battery pack.
  • DO NOT dispose of the battery pack in fire.
  • Exercise extreme caution when handling an overheated battery pack.
